patterns.text: ~~All vault commands trust caller implicitly~~ — CLOSED: `vault auth` mints Ed25519-signed tokens, `api` enforces Bearer auth on privileged endpoints
~~Key signing, revocation, verification specified but zero runtime~~ — CLOSED: `vault keygen`, `vault auth`, `vault verify-sig` all implemented in vault_crypto.py
Small keys (32 bytes), fast signing, deterministic — matches .idf binary pattern
~~Existing 17 events unsigned~~ — CLOSED: signature_cutoff defined in vault_lib.py, legacy events accepted before cutoff, rejected after
`vault keygen --user USER` generates Ed25519 key-pair (KEY.pub + KEY.priv) at ~/.canonic/VAULT/USERS/{USER}/
`vault auth --user USER` mints signed Bearer token (EdDSA, 1h expiry) — GitHub OAuth callback auto-mints via api
`vault verify-sig` validates event signatures against public keys — integrated into api `_verify_token()`
GitHub OAuth flow: /auth/github → GitHub authorize → /auth/github/callback → match USER → mint token → redirect with Bearer
